articleTitle: DeepFake Videos Detection by Using Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: In the last few years, the increasing development of various tools to make fake videos from real videos has been raised. Thus, several models/approaches have been constructed to detect and reveals fake video. Consequently, this research is conducted to propose a new model based on combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and image preprocessing techniques to classify and find the fake video from the real video. To implement and evaluate the proposed model, a MATLAB simulator has been used. The deepFake Images dataset is used for evaluations. This dataset contains 135 real videos as well as 677 fake videos created using different tools on real videos. Two scenarios have been utilized to evaluate the performance of the proposed model which are; dimensions of the training data and different sizes of the training data. The results show that the proposed model has been able to provide better results than the previous model.

articleTitle: EEG and Fractal Dimension for Epileptic Seizures Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Epilepsy is a common neurological disorder that can cause seizures and unconsciousness. Early detection and treatment are crucial for reducing the severity of the injury. Commonly used to diagnose epilepsy, electroencephalograms (EEG) take a lot of time, are susceptible to interference, and can reduce accuracy. This research provides a reliable method for diagnosing epilepsy in EEG data. Each EEG segment is converted into an image using the short-time Fourier transform (STFT). It generates an 8-bit binary image for each TFI. Then, the FDs of the EEG data are estimated and determined using a box-counting approach. The least square-support vector machine (LS-SVM) classifier is employed to identify patients with epilepsy. This study uses original EEG signal data from Bonn University to test the suggested technique, which was 99% accuracy 98% sensitivity, and 99% specificity. Showing the provided method offers a high-accuracy classification and supports neurologists in making an epileptic condition diagnosis and subsequently proposing the proper treatment.

articleTitle: Recognizing human emotions from facial images with the help of Alexnet neural network and genetic algorithm and decision tree classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Facial emotion recognition is a technology that analyzes facial expressions from still images and videos to reveal information about a person’s emotional state. The feeling is one of the essential characteristics of every person. These characteristics will cause different conditions in the body and mind to occur in this structure. In our nature, the main challenge in facial emotion recognition is to achieve fast and reliable performance. Consequently, in this structure, using an optimization algorithm to select the most important features will speed up and reduce the cost of training. For this purpose, we use the genetic algorithm, which still shows promising results in many fields, to obtain the more essential features extracted from the neural network. We use AlexNet to recognize human emotions better. The obtained accuracy results show that our proposed method has shown a significant improvement in facial emotion recognition compared to the two compared methods. In the proposed method, we reached 91.61% accuracy, which compared to the two compared methods, improved the diagnosis by 20%, which shows the superiority of the proposed method compared to the reviewed articles.

articleTitle: A Review: Routing Challenges in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Sensor nodes are what make up the wireless sensor network. Today’s world relies on wireless sensor networks to gather data from various applications. The wireless sensor network may be set up with minimal human input and can be used in different challenging environments. Efficient routing is a critical aspect of WSNs to ensure reliable and timely transmission of data from sensor nodes to a central location or sink. However, WSNs face numerous routing challenges that arise due to the unique characteristics and constraints of these networks. Existing routing protocols aim to address these challenges. The protocols are categorized based on their characteristics, and their advantages and limitations are discussed. This comprehensive survey allows readers to understand the strengths and weaknesses of different routing solutions. By understanding and addressing these routing challenges, researchers and practitioners can design more robust and efficient routing protocols for wireless sensor networks, enabling their successful deployment in various application domains. In this article, we look at the multiple routing protocols and explain why the wireless sensor network is crucial in the modern world.

articleTitle: Monitoring the performance of cloud real-time databases: A firebase case study
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Cloud computing is a special distributed computing model built on top of the Internet infrastructure. Users can access processing power, infrastructure, applications, and even shared content distribution through the cloud as a service available anywhere, at any time. The rapid acceptance of cloud computing technologies in recent years has been astonishing and is gaining traction. Where the Internet of Things (IoT) is emerging as a new technology that connects people, devices, data, and processes to communicate seamlessly, and in IoT environments, smartphones are the most used device due to their smartphone-enabling technologies, such as embedded sensors, Bluetooth, RFID tracking, and near field communications (NFC). In this paper, an IoT model made use of the embedded smartphone sensors to gather data, send it to a cloud Firebase service provider, and store it in Firebase’s real-time database. Additionally, using the Firebase test lab service, various experiments are carried out using 15 smartphone devices to observe the performance of the Firebase real-time database. The results show that using the Firebase console in conjunction with the Google Cloud monitoring dashboard for evaluating and analyzing several key factors that influence the performance of a database.

articleTitle: Automatic Text Summarization Based on Pre-trained Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Due to the current technological eras, increased accessibility of textual information. Numerous people search and read vast amounts of information to ascertain what is necessary, comprehensive, and pertinent to their goals. Most published documents entice readers to read the rest but frequently omit the most important details. As a result, recent years have seen several attempts to automate this process. Despite advances in deep learning and machine learning, the need for many training samples has made achieving good results on low-resource datasets difficult. Additionally, transfer learning cannot be used in conventional training methods and used the pre-trained models to address a related problem rather than creating a new model from scratch to address the same problem and improve the dataset. Promising results were obtained by assessing the text summaries created by adjusting the dataset using already-trained models based on the transformer architecture with reduced training time. Natural language processing has significantly benefited from transfer learning, where a model is initially pre-trained on a data-rich job before being fine-tuned on a downstream task (NLP). Because of its usefulness, transfer learning generated various methods, strategies, and techniques.

articleTitle: The Study of SiO2 and Ag Plasmonic Photonic Crystal Fiber for Optical communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: hexagonal photonic crystal fiber polarization filter is designed in this work, the design is supported by two ellipse Ag rods to achieve surface plasmon resonance (SPR) modes. The finite element method was used to study the effect of the geometrical parameters, hole pitch (p), and photonic crystal holes (d) of the photonic crystal fiber on the performance of the filter. The filtration properties can be modified by changing the structural parameters. With the $\mathrm{p}=1.6\mu \mathrm{m}$ hole pitch, the peak loss of the core mode X-polarized at the resonance wavelength $1\mu \mathrm{m}$ is 285.2 $\mathrm{d}\mathrm{B}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}$. This indicates that the wavelength $(1\mu \mathrm{m})$ can be filtered at a hole pitch of $\mathrm{p}=1.6\mu \mathrm{m}$. In addition, the frequencies $0.9\mu \mathrm{m}0.85\mu \mathrm{m}$ and $0.75\mu \mathrm{m}$ can be filtered at $\mathrm{p}=1.8\mu \mathrm{m}, \mathrm{p}=2\mu \mathrm{m}$, and $\mathrm{p}=2.2$, since the loss peaks are 376.8 $\mathrm{d}\mathrm{B}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}$, 438.14 $\mathrm{d}\mathrm{B}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}$ and 312.6 $\mathrm{d}\mathrm{B}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}$ respectively. The tuneability of the hole pitch (p) offers the flexibility to produce plasmon resonances. At the resonance wavelength 0.75 $\mu \mathrm{m}$ and fixed at $\mathrm{p}=2.2\mu \mathrm{m}$, the confinement losses reduce with values 450.86, 419.38, and 376.81dB/cm with decreasing the circular air holes d, this indicates that at a single resonant frequency, it is possible to control the amount of the confinement losses. Through the results, the design can be used in the field of optical fiber communication as filters for unwanted frequencies.

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning for Intelligent Prediction of Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Cancer is a widespread and potentially lethal illness. There are many different types of cancer. The most common type of cancer is lung cancer. High mortality rates from lung cancer are major public health concerns. Therefore, early detection of cancer reduces the possibility of dying from the disease. A CT scan is used to determine the best course of treatment. Screening with CT has been shown to reduce mortality from lung cancer by detecting the disease at its earliest stages when it manifests as pulmonary nodules. Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems, which employ transfer-learning models, have shown great potential in enhancing the precision and speed of lung cancer diagnosis and treatment. Transfer learning enables adapting pre-existing models to new tasks, facilitating more efficient and effective medical data analysis. Additionally, these systems can assist clinicians in identifying the specific type and stage of lung cancer, which can guide treatment decisions. Our study explores the use of CNN transfer learning with RESNET, MobileNetV2, Xception, and VGG16 models for medical image analysis tasks; res-net achieved the highest testing accuracy in our research, at 0.94, with a testing loss of0.16, which has demonstrated the potential to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of healthcare AI systems.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Single Input Multiple Output Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents a modified buck converter with multiple output circuit and its analysis. This Single Input Multiple Output (SIMO) buck converter has attracted researcher heart as this simple circuit can be harness its benefits especially for those that love outdoor activities as this circuit can charge multiple devices with specific current demand. With the proposed topology, the circuit can promise to constant charge using two separated load or USB devices. However, some study needs to be made as to understand the behavior of the circuit completely in terms of the component selection and the impact of faulty selection of duty cycle control. This study is simulated using PSIM software. The results of the analysis are presented in a proper comparison for a better understanding of the operation.

articleTitle: An Array Antenna Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide Antenna For 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: substrate integrated waveguide (SIW)antenna at millimeter wave is suitable technology, many exciting applications have been made with higher frequency for specific kinds of communication, a wide range of applications, services, and technologies, including short-range communication, future mm-wave mobile communication for fifth-generation (5G) cellular networks, and sensor and imaging systems. Because of the short wavelength, mm-wave frequencies allow for physically smaller antennas and circuits and the availability of a significantly broader bandwidth than microwave frequencies. Because of their extreme sensitivity to atmospheric absorption losses, millimeter-wave antennas must be designed with excellent gain characteristics. Furthermore, Millimeter-wave antennas have a wide bandwidth and are ideal for 5G applications. SIW technology has losses at higher frequencies because of vias. This research creates planar antennas with minimal losses and a high-quality factor by controlling vias of substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) technology. The proposed design results after modifying a single antenna to an array gain increasing to 11.4dB and directivity of 11.7 dB with a wider bandwidth 1.4GHz.

articleTitle: Improving Subset Linear Discriminant Analysis Algorithm Using Overlapping Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: In recent years, there have been many proposals to improve the performance of traditional linear discriminant analysis (LDA). One of these is subset-improving linear discriminant analysis (S-LDA), which is based on clustering the whole set of classes into subsets and performing the LDA locally on these subsets. However, this algorithm suffers from an improper mapping of the classes to the corresponding subset during the testing procedure due to the inevitable discrepancy between the images used for training and those for testing. This discrepancy is caused either by spatial distortion or noise. The wrong mapping is severe when the number of data samples is small which is a common scenario in biometric datasets. In this paper, overlapping clustering is proposed for class clustering, to overcome the aforementioned problem. The proposed algorithm outperforms the S-LDA by 35.4% in mapping accuracy when using the PolyU palmprint database, 36.96%, resp. 33.92% when using left resp. Right palm images from the IIT Delhi Touchless Palmprint Database.

articleTitle: Recognition and Evaluation of Stability Movements in Gymnastics Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Research in the field of computer vision is currently an active and developing area. The evolution of technology and the increasing capabilities of computing and artificial neural networks are factors that have contributed to the advancement of this field. Computer vision systems are relied upon in many fields at present, such as the sports, agricultural, and medical fields, which gave excellent results in all areas on which these systems relied. This article presents the method of relying on computer vision systems in the sports field by distinguishing and evaluating the movements of the male gymnastics player on the ring apparatus, the evaluation process by the referees is complex, and the angle of view of the referee must be clear to ensure the assessment is correct, as the movements are distinguished. Stability in the fixed ring game in gymnastics, a data set was created to distinguish the activities and to evaluate the accuracy of their performance due to the lack of a data set available on the Internet, knowing that these movements are only for men’s gymnastics. One of the convolutional neural network models (yolov7) was adopted after dividing the data into 80% for training and the rest for testing. A set of points on the body based on which the type of movement is known, in addition to the player’s accuracy in executing the action. The time it takes for the player to perform this movement has also been calculated. This system has also been applied to a set of video clips to evaluate player movement. Adopting it to train some players to implement the actions well, the implementation results were very high, as the accuracy reached 95%.

articleTitle: Selecting The Best Control Strategies for Risk Management using Swarm Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: There is no doubt that risks surround the virtual enterprise from every side due to its dynamic work environment, the variety of its components, and its distributed features. The important information linking the owner and the partners is a loophole, which holds back proper decision-making, so the information plays a big role in the decision-making process to manage the risks of the virtual enterprise. Any partner in the virtual enterprise has risk factors that threaten the integrity of the enterprise. When the number of participants in the virtual enterprise, the quantity of risk factors, and the events increases, the search space will largely increase. The investigated model is a distributed decision-making process in virtual enterprise risk programming. Many control strategies can be chosen for each risk. These strategies represent the mechanisms that are used to deal with every risk that may affect the institution or one of its members This study aims to discover an appropriate decision approach that can improve the overall risk management performance of the entire enterprise. This work is based on employing the Spotted Hyenas optimization Algorithm (SHO) to obtain the best selection of selected strategies for each risk factor. Results show that the algorithm works very effectively, by identifying the best strategies to address the risks related to the flow of information between the owner and the partner. A comparison with previous results is conducted, where the effect of the algorithm appears to reduce the risks of the virtual enterprise positively.

articleTitle: Application of Inverse Fluidized Bed Reactor for Removal of Selenium Compounds: A Mini Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: (Se) is a metal that is disseminated into various environmental compartments both by human and natural processes. It is often released as the hazardous elements selenate and selenite. The removal of selenium compounds from wastewater is a significant challenge due to their toxic effects on the environment and human health. In this study, an inverse fluidized bed reactor (IFBR) was evaluated as a potential method for removing selenium compounds from wastewater. The performance of the IFBR was assessed by measuring the removal efficiency of selenate, selenite, and chemical oxygen demand (COD) in the influent and effluent wastewater. The results showed that the IFBR was able to remove 94% of selenate and reduce COD significantly. These findings were compared with previously published research, indicating that the IFBR is a more effective method for removing selenate compared to other treatment methods. These results demonstrate the potential of the IFBR as a promising technology for the treatment of wastewater containing selenium compounds. Further research is needed to optimize the IFBR process and scale up the technology for practical applications in the industry.

articleTitle: A Survey on Online Courses: State of the Art and Current Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has driven a transformative shift in education, leading to the widespread adoption of online learning as the primary mode of education. This article provides an overview of the current state of online courses, exploring their potential as a mainstream learning approach. Motivated by the pandemic’s impact on education, this research aims to identify the challenges and opportunities associated with online learning. The research conducted a comprehensive review of existing literature and analyzed studies, reports, and surveys related to online courses. The results highlight the advantages of online learning, such as flexibility and accessibility, while acknowledging challenges like the digital divide and limited social interactions. Ultimately, this study emphasizes the potential of online courses to enhance education and calls for addressing challenges to optimize their effectiveness. By leveraging the strengths of online learning, educators and policymakers can shape a more inclusive and accessible future of education.

articleTitle: Investigation of Intercell Interference for Cell Edge Users
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Intercell interference (ICI) is considered a critical challenge from earlier mobile generations and it is getting more attention with the arrival of 5G. Its promises of higher data rates, spectral efficiency, and better system capacity that are faced by the shortage of spectrum resources, which require updating the network by dense cells and reusing the frequencies to accomplish these promises. which leads to arising of cell-edge user problems. This paper introduces the concept of ICI in two scenarios. Throughput, good-put, and block error rate (BLER) are used as metrics for the analysis and evaluation of the network’s performance. This paper focuses on cell edge users. The results show these victim users have a throughput of 1.73 and 2.24 Mbps when ICI cells become closer to the cell of interest, while showing improvement in the throughput to reach about 3.14 and 3.45 as the distance from the ICI increases.

articleTitle: Design of A Smart Microgrid for Predictive Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The exploration of artificial neural networks (ANNs) in the realm of renewable energy-based smart grids is the primary focus of this study. The difficulties associated with the integration of renewable energy sources into the electrical grid, primarily due to their inherent variability and intermittency, are identified as the main problem. The smart grid technologies development is recognized as a solution to enhance the grid’s efficiency and reliability. It is suggested that ANNs could significantly contribute to the smart grid system performance improvement. An examination of renewable energy-based smart grid key features, integration-related challenges, and potential benefits of incorporating ANNs are presented. Research on ANNs’ application in various smart grid systems components, such as energy demand forecasting, energy generation and storage optimization, and grid stability management, are reviewed. Data division for this study was accomplished through random subsampling, with 80% of the data forming the training set and the remaining 20% comprising the testing set. A comparison between these two groups was subsequently performed. Following the computations to determine the Mean Squared Errors (MSEs) for a percentage range between 60% and 90%, the study concludes by highlighting areas requiring additional research to fully exploit the potential of ANNs in renewable energy-based smart grids. In this study, the main objective is to understand the role of ANNs in optimizing the performance of renewable energy-based smart grids and identify areas for future research.

articleTitle: Dispersion compensating fiber with Brillouin fiber laser generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Short linewidth light lasers are essential for a wide range of applications, including quantum computing, spectroscopy, and sensing. Stimulated Brillouin scattering is an intriguing method for achieving extremely coherent light laser output. The demonstration of an unstable pulsed Brillouin erbium fiber laser (BFL) operating at kHz is shown here. The BFL works at 1550.1 nm, which is 0.09 nm higher than the Brillouin pump wavelength since the dispersion compensating fiber was pumped over the 24.77 mW threshold. It has an extreme power of 0.7 dBm, a side-mode suppression ratio of 29 dB, and a pump power of 59.12 mW at 980 nm. Due to the intrinsic instability in relaxation oscillation, which generates the nonlinear self-pulsing mechanism in the BEFL cavity, the BEFL produced a pulse train running at 200.9 kHz with a 24.77 mW pump. The pulse frequency was raised to 3.02 MHz. The pump power has been increased to 59.12 mW. Yet, as the pump power was raised further, more than one pulse was produced. This is the first example of generating kHz pulses in a BFL cavity. The laser system is straightforward, small, and all-fiber. These are the attempts of experimental work to realize the BFL with Q-switched multi-wavelength output using a specific length of DCF to generate the pulses.

articleTitle: Weighting Heart Disease Criteria Using Multi-Criteria Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Heart disease describes a group of conditions that affect the heart and there are many different factors including lifestyle, medical history, family history, and so on that may cause this complex disease. It is therefore important to consider multiple criteria, such as smoking status, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels to make informed decisions about patient priority management and treatment of HD. Multicriteria Decision Making (MCDM) allows us to identify and weigh the importance of each criterion. This approach can enhance the quality of patient care and improve clinical outcomes. Therefore, weighting HD criteria using MCDM is an essential step in achieving better healthcare outcomes in the management of HD. The FWZIC method was used in this study to weigh 11 heart disease parameters with the assistance of four cardiologists. The results of the criterion weights were without any difference in the preferences of the respective expert. Therefore, this method is flexible, robust, and useful in complex real-world problems.

articleTitle: Land Use Geodatabase of Baghdad City Creation Using Geographic Information System Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This research aims to create a geographic database for Baghdad city due to its great importance being the capital, its important location, and its large urban expansion to produce a geographic map for land use with important characteristics of it using geographical information system (GIS). Vector data (shapefiles), raster data (satellite images), and Non-Spatial Data (population statistical data) were used to study the area in this research. All this data is imported into an empty geographical database that is created using ArcGIS software 10.4. The result showed accurate geographical maps of the study area and the defining land uses through its administrative sub-divisions, government (general sector (and nongovernment (special sector) projects established on it, and its connection to the road network, in addition to the statistical population data within the administrative regions. Thus, it became possible to access detailed project information with ease, and it is hoped that this research will serve in the development of work toward proposing suitable lands for future projects establishment.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Deep Learning Techniques Used to Identify Social Media Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Using social media is one of the easy means that can be used for untruthful people to spread rumors, fake news, and falsified information. Thus, it becomes necessary for researchers to invent intelligent tools that can deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques for this reason. this paper presents a comparative study to test GraphSAGE and Node2vec embedding methods, such methods are used to transform the input data into a meaningful format used for classification through the computation of vector representations of a node based on random walks in the graph. Such methods can be considered as feature extraction methods. In particular, using GraphSAGE outperformed the Node2vec in terms of the well-known classification evaluation measures.

articleTitle: Proposing an IOT Secure Framework for Monitoring COVID-19 Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Traditional health monitoring technology and the IoT have revolutionized e-health. Sensors and WBAN devices provide real-time health monitoring services. IoT gadgets are causing technology and security issues every minute. Sensor-based devices’ data must be discreet, trustworthy, and secure for public network connection. COVID-19 patient monitoring systems use IoT-based applications, networks, and perception layers. Each layer must address privacy and security issues. Some research has addressed security concerns. We advocate using CoAP and MQTT in a security architecture for a real-time COVID-19 patient monitoring system to ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity. Since sensor data is constantly transferred between layers, this security system protects it with HTTPs. Thus, they are rarely hacked. This paper examines how CoAP and HTTPS protect the security architecture of Internet of Things-based real-time health systems. HTTPs and CoAP provide complete security solutions because the percentage of packet loss during transmission is 0%. The Cooja simulator was used to simulate the network COVID-19 Patient Monitoring System.

articleTitle: Improve of Neonatal Seizure Detection based on EEG Signal using K-mean clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Seizures are one of the most frequent medical emergencies. They are identified by visual electroencephalography (EEG) results assessment, and neuroscientific professionals are responsible for their care. This method takes a long time, and the results are inconsistent. A system for identifying epileptic seizures from EEG data that is collected from healthy individuals and epileptic patients is presented in this research to solve this issue. This system is based on a study of EEG data utilizing the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and both linear and nonlinear classifiers, Neonatal human EEG recordings are included in the dataset used in proposed model. A 19-channel EEG equipment was used to record the brainwave activity of 79 term newborns referred to the NICU at the Helsinki University Hospital. Five patients with structural seizure and non-seizure annotations were chosen for the experimental studies from these databases. Three experts independently identified the presence of seizures and non-seizures in the EEGs using visual interpretation, while statistical features were retrieved using the K-mean algorithm and the Least-Squares Support Vector Machine (LS-SVM) was utilized to identify seizures. To improve the model’s performance, (statistical and Hjorth and zero crossing) features were extracted, K-means’ feature selection using LS-SVM, and obtaining high accuracy 99.58% by P3-O1.

articleTitle: Optimization of Dataset Based on Hybrid Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Hardly a day goes by that we do not hear the emergence of a invention from here, and a scientific breakthrough from there. The world of artificial intelligence and machines embodied in technology has become an essential element in our lives, sharing most of our daily lives and helping us in most of our work and tasks, whether easy or difficult. The researchers are racing to develop programs and technologies related to machine learning and deep learning and the development of algorithms that support artificial intelligence programs, including algorithms inspired by nature developed by researchers to reduce and identify features and reduce the complexity of computational that led to obtaining high accuracy in results. Algorithms derived from natural phenomena emerged at the beginning of the nineteenth century, such as inspired algorithms (GA, PSO, ABC, GWO, BA, ALT). etc. In this article, three types of inspired algorithms (GA), (GWO) and (ANT) are used for the extraction and elimination of features that are implemented on the same dataset and making a comparison between them in terms of optimizing accuracy, runtime, features selection, and fitness value.

articleTitle: New Approach for Effective Twitter Sentiments Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: People can share and express their perspectives on various topics, have discussions with various communities, or post global messages on social networking sites such as Twitter, Facebook, and Google. These sites are quickly gaining popularity because they enable people to do these things. The discipline of analyzing people’s feelings based on the content of tweets on Twitter has seen much progress recently. Finding the most effective sentiment classifier to place tweets in the appropriate categorization is the most challenging aspect of conducting Twitter sentiment analysis. As a result of this study’s findings, a new and improved approach to word representation has been suggested. This approach uses the contribution of sentiment information into the conventional TF-IDF algorithm and generates weighted word vectors. This research provides a comparison between the two methods (TF-IDF and VADER), in addition to the use of machine learning and deep learning algorithms (KNN, RF, LSTM, and ANN), to choose the best algorithms to build a robust model that is capable of accurately analyzing sentiments. This comparison aims to determine which algorithms are the most effective for building such a model. The findings demonstrate that using TF-IDF in conjunction with the RF algorithm results in an accuracy of 98.7%, more significant than the accuracy achieved by other algorithms employing the same TF-IDF or the other VADER technique.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of Bohman Windowing Performance for UFMC with Higher QAM Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the performance of different windowing techniques for high-level quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) in universal filtered multicarrier (UFMC) systems. The focus is on comparing the impact of different windowing types on bit error rate (BER) performance, peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), and out-of-band emission (OOBE). The present study assesses the performance of the Bohman window in the context of QAM levels, namely 256QAM, 512QAM, and 1024QAM, under a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 15 dB. The findings indicate that utilization of the Bohman window yields a 3.21% enhancement in BER performance, a 1.01% reduction in PAPR, and a decrease in OOBE by 62.46 dBW/Hz for the 1024QAM in contrast to conventional UFMC. At 20 dB SNR, the BER is still lower than the traditional by 1.16%, but PAPR remains unchanged.

articleTitle: Interference Mitigation and Radar Privacy Protection Under MIMO Shared Spectrum Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: To efficiently utilize the available spectrum at the sub-6 GHz band, shared spectrum systems have been investigated recently. However, this spectrum-sharing strategy brings a challenging problem of interference mitigation between the two shared systems. In this study, we design a neural-network-based optimized precoder that is used by a mobile user to communicate with a base station in a cellular system using the same frequency band as a nearby radar. The precoder is designed to guarantee minimum interference towards the radar while keeping the communications data rate above a pre-specified level using the available power budget of the user. We propose to enforce an imaginary user to the precoder design problem, in addition to the real user, to delude the intruder and make the radar privacy violation task more challenging. Also, we train a neural network to evaluate the robustness of the proposed approach relative to the standard approach where only real user information is used. Compared to the standard precoder design methods, the proposed method shows a better privacy property with a mean absolute angular distance of $15^{\wedge}\circ$ as opposed to $0.3^{\wedge}\circ$ in the previous approach.

articleTitle: A Slotted Peano-Type Fractal Based Highly Miniaturized Substrate Integrated Waveguide Dual-Mode BPF for Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: A miniaturized substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) band pass filter (BPF) based on fractal geometry is introduced in this paper. The proposed filter is designed by etching a slot on the top layer of the structure base on a Peano-type fractal. The size of the filter was miniaturized by applying the Peano-type fractal so that the filter was made to resonate at a frequency of 2.82 GHz instead of 10 GHz. The proposed filter exhibits two transmission poles within its passband, which are observed at frequencies of 2.77 GHz and 2.9 GHz. The filter’s boundaries are approximately equivalent to 0.572$\times$ 0.589$\lambda \mathrm{g}^{2}$. The insertion loss (IL) associated with this technique is 0.53 dB, while the fractional bandwidth has been calculated to be 19.43%. A substrate of Rogers RO4003C, with a relative dielectric constant of 3.5, a loss tangent of 0.0027, and a thickness of 0.2032 mm.

Author Keywords: SIW wide band fractal pass filter

articleTitle: Implementing a Modified Low-complexity U-Net Model for Segmenting Brain Tumors
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Accurate segmenting of brain tumors has become a challenge recently. Manual segmentation needs experts with high skills and takes a long time. This challenge motivates several researchers to introduce various models to solve the problem with different degrees of success. The main issue with these models is that the model accuracy increased proportionally with model complexity, which may develop further difficulties in the improvement stage. Thus, this paper aims to implement a low-complexity model with several layers less than the standard U-Net, achieving higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art models. The proposed model has obtained more than a 40% reduction in layers and better performance than the available models. The dataset BRAST 2018 is employed with a total image of 7750. The proposed model attained a 0.9222 dice score, 98.99% accuracy, and 0.1889 loss value. The findings indicate that this model has promising applications and can be used in clinical settings to segment different brain tumor sub-regions. Such models facilitate the tumor localization and classification stages.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Hybrid FSO/Fiber Optic Communication System under Different Modulation Schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Optical wireless is used when the FSO system implementation fails due to turbulent weather conditions that deteriorate and thus will degrade signal strength in transmission. To overcome these issues, a multi-channel FSO transmitter and dispersion-compensating fiber (DCF) were used in the optical link with high transmit power. In this work, a hybrid FSO/Fiber Optic (FSO/FO) is proposed to explore the best modulation type under different climatic conditions, in which the hybrid correlation bit error rate (BER) and quality factor (Q-factor) are investigated. Erbium-doped fiber is adopted and a multi-channel transmitter is used with different states of single and dual channels with the same input power. It is observed that the dual channel shows better Q-factor results than the single channel. The proposed system achieves better results in 10 Gb/s rain conditions for optical fibers with a length of 40 km for the inspection range from 1000m to 12000m when the input power is 160 mW. The proposed system achieved a Q factor equal to 5.7 when the DPSK modulation is at a transmission distance of 12000 m for the fiber link and a Q factor equal to 6.7 when the DPSK modulation is after 12000 meters for the FSO.

articleTitle: Review of Beamforming’s Energy Consumption Algorithms for (5G) Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Power Consumption (PC) algorithms for 5G communications are cutting-edge technology revolutionizing how our modern world communicates and operates. These algorithms help reduce PC and enable mobile devices to consume far less energy while maintaining high connection speeds. However, by reducing the amount of energy required for communication, these algorithms can significantly extend device battery life. By optimizing Internet connection speeds, users can also consistently experience faster web downloads and fewer macro outages. This revolutionary technology has opened up countless new possibilities for the future of communications and data networks. This study shows that various algorithms, including machine learning, reinforcement learning, and heuristic algorithms, can be used to optimize PC in 5G networks.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methods to Detect Autism Among Children: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurological condition that permanently affects a person’s ability to learn languages, speak, think clearly, and interact with others. In the embryonic stages, its symptoms typically emerge. The conditions of ASD can be improved by identifying and treating them early. ASD is either genetic or caused by environmental factors. Currently, the only methods utilized to diagnose ASD are clinically based-tests. In addition to requiring extended diagnostic time, this will also result in a sharp increase in medical expenses. Machine Learning (ML) approaches are being used to supplement traditional methods to increase diagnoses’ accuracy and response time. The paper presents a review of the recent literature on different ML approaches for the classification and identification of ASD in children and the study of the characteristics of ASD. The concept of ASD and the techniques used to discover it are explained; at the end of the paper. The most prominent techniques used in ML to identify children with ASD were discussed in detail. Finally, The main objective of our study is to focus on whether the child is at risk of developing ASD spectrum disorder in its early stages And highlight the importance of early diagnosis using ML methods to reduce the symptoms of the disease.

articleTitle: DDOS attack detection using machine learning algorithm in SDN network
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: In this research, we highlight SDN networks that exist in wide applications to manage several routers and switches by a small number of engineers that face several types of attacks, the most important of which is a DDOS attack, as it leads to the prohibitions of networks from working and to solve such a problem by identifying and discovering such attacks. We need fast algorithms like machine learning to detect attacks. specifically focusing on the OpenDaylight controller. We employ the Mininet network simulator to emulate the SDN network and implement the OpenFlow protocol to enable communication between the controller and the network devices. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of various machine learning algorithms in predicting DDoS attacks in real time to protect the SDN infrastructure. To achieve this goal, we analyze the performance of several machine learning classifiers, including XGBoost, Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), on a simulated dataset replicating real-world DDoS attack conditions. Our empirical results demonstrate that XGBoost, LR, SVM, and KNN show strong classification performance; with XGBoost, we get the best accuracy of 99.26%, and LR of 99.24 %, standing out for their computational efficiency. In contrast, the NB classifier exhibits limitations in classification accuracy. This study contributes to the growing body of research on SDN security, highlighting the potential of machine learning algorithms in detecting and mitigating DDoS attacks in SDN environments.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: Single-Channel Informed Spontaneous Speech Separation by NNMF on a Uniform Filterbank
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The paper summarizes two algorithms to process spontaneous conversation, which contain two speech formats, a mixture, and dialogue of two speakers. Mixture format (called overlapped speech), when they are speaking simultaneously. Dialogue is when only one speaker is speaking and the other is silent. The first algorithm is overlapped speech detection. The algorithm processes the spontaneous conversation to produce two segregated mixture and dialog speech segments. The second algorithm supposes that the speaker diarization corpus processes the dialogue speech segments. The corpus outputs two sets of speech segments, first for the first speaker and second for the second speaker. Inputs of the second algorithm are two. The first is mixture speech (output of the first algorithm). Since the corpus output segments belong to the mixture format speakers, these segments assist the separation process (informed speech separation). The two algorithms are tested for 66 spontaneous conversations. The average EMISS of the overlapped speech algorithm is 0.4%. For the speech separation, the average SDR is 3.05 dB, SIR 9.8dB, and SAR 4.65 dB. On a uniform filter bank domain, the mathematical model of this paper’s informed speech separation algorithm exploited Non-Negative Matrix Factorization NNMF.

articleTitle: A Look at The 3GPP Standard’s Current Positioning of 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Here, we depict the ongoing 3GPP Delivery 16 particularly for situating in 5G organizations, which is currently being developed. To address the issues of an extensive variety of administrative, business, and modern use cases, the detail indicates situating signals, estimations, methods, and framework engineering. Accordingly, when contrasted with what was beforehand conceivable with LTE, 5G essentially advances situating capacities. Utilizing 3GPP reenactment situations that have been settled upon, the demonstrative situating execution is assessed, and it is found that the 90 percentile precision goes from a couple of meters to a couple of decimeters, contingent upon the procedures and suppositions utilized.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation with Energy Balancing for UAVs Assisted VANETs based Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)

authors.preferredName: Baydaa Abdul Hassan Khalaf Al Ghzawi

abstract: Vehicular Ad hoc Networks (VANETs) is one among the most trending research area where it is concentrated by maximum of the industrial and academic sectors and as well it is utilized in lot of the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) based applications. VANETs are equipped with certain special characteristics such as fast-moving vehicle, unpredictable mobility and frequent topographical modifications in the network that directly affects the performance and as well due to ground level obstacles data transmission is interrupted during communication. In order to maintain the speed of the vehicles and to overcome the network from ground level obstacles Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are introduced in VANETs. Later on, vehicles are high increased in the network so that it is essential to improve the effective of UAVs assisted VANETs. For that purpose, in this paper Resource Allocation with Energy Balancing (RAEB) is proposed which is categorized into three segments they are UAV network construction, effective load balancing process and improved UAV energy utilization. Through valuable resource allocation and energy monitoring the delay and overhead rate is reduced that helps to improve the packet delivery ratio and energy efficiency of the network. The implementation of the proposed RAEB-UAVs is carried out in NS2 and the parameters which are considered for the process of comparative analysis are packet delivery ratio, end-to-end delay, routing overhead and throughput and as well it is compared with the earlier research like PRO-UAVS and RDJOUAVs. From the results it is proven that the proposed RAEBUAVs achieve better overall performance when compared with the earlier approaches.

articleTitle: Clustering Algorithms Comparison for University of Anbar Researchers’ Google Scholar Profiles
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Clustering is an important web mining technique that is extensively used in a variety of fields, including pattern recognition, image processing, and data analysis. K-means and K-medoids are two popular clustering algorithms that attempt to group data points that are similar into clusters. Although both algorithms have the same fundamental goal, they differ in their approaches to cluster formation and the selection of cluster centers. The K-means and K-medoids algorithms are compared in this study in terms of their strengths and weaknesses, complexity, and applicability to real-world issues. The K-Means algorithm appears to be performing better than the K-Mediods algorithm, with a higher silhouette score, Calinski-Harabasz index, and Davies-Bouldin index. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the efficacy of two popular clustering algorithms, k-means and k-medoids. In our scenario, we fetched a dataset from the Google Scholar profiles of researchers associated with the Iraqi University of Anbar. The email "uoanbar.edu.iq" was used to retrieve the dataset used in this research. The study compares the two algorithms’ performance in terms of output and measurement evaluation, to determine which algorithm is better suited to the situation at hand. Our findings show that k-means clustering outperforms k-medoids in terms of output quality as well as computational efficiency, making it the preferred algorithm for this situation. The research adds to the increasing body of knowledge about clustering algorithms and their applicability to real-world datasets.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Routing Protocol for the Internet of Drone Things in the VANET Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) is a highly emerging technology in the intelligent transmission system. Its special features such as high speed, random topology, and recurrent change in topology lead to ineffective communication in VANETs. To overcome such drawbacks drones are introduced in VANETs and to achieve effective communication routing needs to get improved. So that it is possible to protect the VANETs from delay, overhead, and link failures. In this paper, a Multipath Routing Protocol for Collaborative Internet of Drone Things (MRP-CIoDTs) is proposed to improve communication stability during data transmission between the source and the destination. The major segments of the proposed protocol are Zone based AOMDV (Z-AOMDV) routing protocol, Zone based spatial coverage, and mobility models. Through the Z-AOMDV protocol, the best intermediate hops are chosen for data transmission between the source and the destination. In case link failure happens immediately through drones the data gets transmitted. Through zone based spatial coverage model the selection path is validated and finalized. Finally, communication is initiated using the determined mobility models. Through this process, the delay and overhead can be reduced. The proposed MRP-CIoDTs is implemented using OMNET++ and the parameters that are considered for the performance analysis are computational overhead, throughput, packet delivery ratio, and computational delay as well as it is compared with the earlier approaches such as NRCLM and DPUAV. From the outcome, it is understood that the proposed MRP-CIoDTs achieved low computational delay and overhead as well as achieved high packet delivery ratio and throughput when compared with the earlier methods.

articleTitle: Android Malware Detection Based on Grammatical Evaluation Algorithm and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Smartphones are prevalent in the modern digital era and typically work on open-source software, which makes it easier for malicious code to enter the system. Android malware infiltrates the smartphone and corrupts the user’s sensitive and personal data. So Multiple methods have been developed to reduce the risks presented by malware. Signature-based detection is the most common method for detecting Android malware. This procedure cannot detect unknown malicious software, which is considered a disadvantage. Due to this issue, Machine Learning (ML) has been implemented to detect malware threats. The objective of ML algorithms is to improve classification precision. Due to the complexity of actual datasets,, conventional classifiers are ineffective at classifying malicious applications. The security sector has begun to identify hybrid machine-learning systems. This paper proposes a hybrid system for Android smartphone malware detection. We developed a detection model using Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and Grammatical Evaluation (GE) to determine the optimal parameters. Three well-known datasets in the field of Android Malware are used to apply the experimental results. Compared to the results derived through conventional parameter adjustment, the performance of the proposed model was superior. Our method attained an accuracy of 98% for CICMalDroid-2020, 99.02% for Drebin, and 99.28% for Malgenome, according to the results obtained.

articleTitle: Ancient Textual Restoration Using Deep Neural Networks: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Ancient texts are important because they connect us with ancient civilizations, through which gain cultural, religious, and scientific knowledge, but these texts are often damaged over time due to environmental factors and the method of preservation that affects them, so the task of restoring these texts was one of the necessary tasks for specialists and researchers in ancient sciences. This paper provides an overview of the current state of research in this field. The review would examine the different approaches and methods used, the successes of these methods, and the challenges that need to be addressed in the future. The literature review would also cover the various types of datasets of ancient texts that have been restored using deep neural networks, such as manuscripts, inscriptions, and scrolls, as the different languages and the involved scripts.

articleTitle: A Novel Mobility and Connectivity Aware Stable Clustering Approach for Effective Communication in Flying Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: F1ying Ad-Hoc Network (FANET) is a network which consists of group of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that are interconnected in a wireless medium. FANETs are self-organized with few special characteristics such as low cost, user friendly, easy to deploy, fast performance and collectively adaptable to any kind of situation. Due to its high mobility and dynamic nature it consists of certain design challenges to achieve effective communication. Attaining effective performance with lower energy consumption in FANETs is quite complication task. To overcome this drawback in this research A Novel Mobility and Connectivity Aware Stable Clustering Approach (MCASC) is proposed. Significant parameter-based cluster head (CH) selection is performed by considering the parameters such as distance, mobility factor, residual energy, network connectivity, and correlation factor. High mobility of the UAVs is intelligently controlled by this CH selection process which helps to reduce the energy consumption and delay likewise increases the delivery ratio and energy efficiency. The proposed MCASC-FANETs are implemented in NS2 and as well the parameters which are considered for the process of comparative analysis are energy efficiency, energy consumption, packet delivery rate and end-to-end delay where the outcome is compared with the recent approaches like JRUC-FANET and CBRP-FANET. From the results and discussion, it is understood that the proposed MCASC-FANETs attain high efficiency and packet delivery ratio when compared with the earlier researches.

Author Keywords: Mobility and Connectivity Aware Stable Clustering

articleTitle: Reducing latency in fog computing through resource allocation optimization using cuckoo search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The rapid growth of Internet of Things (IoT) applications has introduced various challenges, including quality of service, latency, disconnections, and delay. Despite the emergence of fog computing, these challenges persist. This abstract presents a new resource allocation mechanism to effectively tackle the latency challenges in fog computing. Our approach involves distributing requests and scheduling tasks using a queuing mechanism with three proposed lists: block, wait, and scheduling that based on loaded factors to select available nodes. To optimize resource allocation, we introduce the cuckoo search algorithm that measures the distance between users and fog nodes to select the nearest and available nodes for request processing, this algorithm significantly reduces latency. Our evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach by comparing latency measurements with and without the cuckoo search algorithm. The results exhibit a remarkable reduction in latency, with the algorithm cutting the distance in half, leading to an overall latency reduction. The proposed resource allocation mechanism, combined with the use of the cuckoo search algorithm, delivers tangible improvements in latency, thereby enhancing the overall performance of fog computing systems.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Consumption In IoT Networks: Reducing Sensors Energy By Timing Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The number of sensors is constantly increasing as a result of the urgent need for smart homes, factories, hospitals, military facilities, etc. Consequently, the energy consumption of these mostly battery-driven devices has increased, and due to their continuous work without stopping, it became necessary to think about and study to reduce energy consumption. In this paper, we are suggesting reducing energy consumption by establishing a schedule to turn the IoT sensors on and off according to the user demand and under their control. This research proposed a different On/Off time scenario when sensors are distributed as groups, each connected to gateways (Microcontrollers), which in turn are connected to the main server via a wireless connection, the Microcontrollers continuously check the readings sent by these sensors. The results showed the proposed algorithm increased the residual energy of the network by assigning sleeping intervals depending on the covered area and the number of neighboring nodes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks with Optimization Algorithms: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Wireless multimedia sensor networks (WMSN) have become increasingly important in various fields due to their affordability, low power consumption, and ability to operate autonomously with diverse functions. WMSN plays a crucial role in boosting tracking and monitoring applications with wireless multimedia audio and video sensor networks. However, efficiently managing and transmitting real-time multimedia data in these networks poses challenges such as energy consumption, data aggregation, and maintaining quality of service (QoS). To address these challenges and enhance WMSN performance, optimization algorithms have been introduced. This paper provides a thorough overview of Optimization algorithms for WMSNs, with a focus on highlighting their key features. Additionally, it includes a detailed classification and comparative analysis based on relevant metrics. The paper also addresses design challenges and outlines potential areas for future research.

articleTitle: Security-Reliability Analysis of FSO Communications Over Generalized F Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the security and reliability aspects of a multiuser free space optical (MU-FSO) system when exposed to eavesdropper attacks. The system experiences atmospheric turbulence, specifically generalized Fisher-Snedecor F turbulence, which leads to significant signal fading. To enhance the security and reliability of the MU-FSO system, the study employs three scheduling schemes: optimal scheduling (OS), round-robin scheduling (RS), and cumulative distribution function scheduling (CS). The paper derives precise expressions for the intercept probability (IP) and outage probability (OP) of the MU-FSO system to compare the performance of these opportunistic scheduling schemes considering the impact of atmospheric turbulence and path loss. Additionally, the paper presents simplified expressions for the asymptotic behavior of IP and OP with acceptable accuracy. Numerical results demonstrate how the performance of the MU-FSO system in terms of secrecy and reliability is influenced by factors such as the conditions of the main and wiretap channels, distances between legitimate users, the number of active users, and the power levels of the legitimate and eavesdropping links. Monte Carlo simulations are used to verify the correctness of the numerical results.

articleTitle: Scanner Method For Modeling and Manufacturing of 3d Printable Upper Limb Orthosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The study aims to design and manufacture orthosis using the programming process instead of the common traditional method in manufacturing orthosis, which requires several steps, more cost, time, and less accuracy. This work makes a new design of orthosis for patients with wrist drop deformity due to radial nerve palsy, by using a different method in the formation of the 3D model, where several images were taken over the patient’s hand, and then processed by (meta shape) program to produce the 3D model of the hand. After processing the 3D model of the hand, the new design of the orthosis was created using the mesh mixer program relying on the 3D model of the patient’s hand and then printed through the 3D printer from polylactic acid. The presented and discussed results show the new orthosis is comfortable, and light, contains ventilation enough for the skin, and has enough strength to prevent mechanical failure.

articleTitle: Exploring Technological Success Factors of Big Data in E-Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Big data plays an important role in the development of e-learning systems. There are many factors affecting its implementation and success with e-learning systems. This study aims to identify the implementation success factors related to big data within e-learning systems. To identify these elements, a comprehensive examination of the literature was done by using exploratory and single-case research approaches, the study used Basrah University as the case study to assess the success factors of big data in their e-learning system. Additionally, survey and expert interviews were conducted to validate the literature review’s conclusions and identify further factors. The collected data were analyzed using NVivo software to identify themes and sub-themes. To assess the quantitative survey data, machine learning methods are combined with qualitative analysis using a Random Forest Classifier. The finding showed that five factors should be considered which can aid in the creation of more efficient e-learning systems namely: Positive Impact on Students, Faculty/Staff Support and Training, Effective Content Design, System Functionality and Usability, and Assessment and Feedback. The results of this study can be used to improve learning outcomes by developing more efficient big data analytics-integrated e-learning systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Regression Approach for Estimating Energy Consumption of Appliances in Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This paper attempts to use machine learning algorithms to estimate the energy consumption of appliances in a smart home environment. This work aims to promote awareness among smart home systems and users about their appliances’ energy consumption and guide them toward energy-saving practices. To achieve this, three machine learning algorithms, namely Decision Forest (DF), Boosted Decision Tree (BDT), and Linear Regression (LR), were chosen for regression tasks to estimate the energy consumption of several appliances accurately. The time-series datasets, namely appliance energy prediction datasets, are used for training and testing the algorithms. The Cross-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRISP-DM) methodology, which comprises six processing phases, was employed in this work. The test is performed by utilizing 10-fold cross-validation. The results obtained assess the models’ performance in predicting the appliances’ energy consumption. The experimental results indicate that the three models exhibit varying degrees of accuracy in predicting energy consumption, as measured by their respective R-squared values. Among the three models, the random forest model exhibited superior performance by achieving the highest R2 values of 0.62 and 0.54 during the training and testing phases, respectively.

articleTitle: Ultrafiltration Membrane Process for Municipal Wastewater Treatment: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The objective of this study is to present ultrafiltration (UF) technology as a practical and efficient option for wastewater treatment in various contexts. The continuous depletion of freshwater resources due to the growing population and other factors has prompted researchers to seek innovative and cost-effective solutions. The utilization of membrane technology for water recovery and reuse from diverse types of wastewater has become increasingly prevalent.This comprehensive review highlights the most significant UF methods and their applications in the treatment of wastewater. Statistical information and specific results from previous studies are incorporated to provide a quantitative perspective on the performance of UF technology. The average removal efficiencies of UF for suspended solids, colloids, and microorganisms are reported as 95%, 98%, and 99.9%, respectively, based on a meta-analysis of50 relevant studies. The review also highlights the cost-effectiveness of UF technology compared to traditional treatment methods, with an estimated reduction in operational costs by 30% and a water recovery rate of up to 95%. UF technology offers a promising solution for effective wastewater treatment and water reuse. Its high removal efficiencies, broad applicability, and potential cost savings make it a viable option for addressing the challenges posed by water scarcity and pollution.

articleTitle: Developing a Robust Model to Detect Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder Using LS-SVM and EEG brain signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is the term used to describe the most common psychiatric disease in children today. One of the most significant challenges to this disorder’s management and treatment is early diagnosis among children with ADHD. Electroencephalography (EEG) plays a crucial role in evaluating the neurophysiology of ADHD because of its capability to reveal complex brain activity. This study included 45 ADHD patients and 45 healthy and suggested a new model for ADHD detection using frequency domain features combined with a least square support vector machine (LS-SVM). The statistical features were tested to find the optimal feature sets based on K-means that were extracted using discrete wavelet transform (DWT). Putting the selected features into two classifiers, LS-SVM and Naive-Bayes. The performance of the proposed model was evaluated by 10-fold cross-validation, specificity metrics, and other precision sensitivity. 19 channels’ results and the mean accuracies were recorded and calculated. The proposed model obtained an average accuracy of 96.49% with LS-SVM, while it recorded 6S.39% with the Naive-Bayes classifier that is used to classify ADHD.

articleTitle: 3DCNN Model for Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Evaluation in Echocardiography
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Echocardiography is a popular medical imaging technique for identifying cardiovascular issues. One of the most critical indicators of heart function is the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). However, there is inter-observer variability in the evaluation of the ejection fraction. This study aims to calculate the EF value that can be used to identify cardiomyopathy (abnormalities in the heart muscle that can lead to heart failure), evaluate whether a patient is eligible for specific chemotherapies, and establish the need for specific medical devices. This study presents a new 3DCNN model for video datasets containing echocardiogram sequences capturing heart motion throughout time. The proposed 3DCNN architecture efficiently captures the spatiotemporal patterns in echocardiograms using temporal information. The model can extract spatial and temporal information from the input data by including three-dimensional convolutions. The network architecture has multiple 3D convolutional layers, max pooling, and fully-connected layers for regression tasks. This model assessed our methodology using the EchoNet-Dynamic dataset to confirm its efficacy. Also, this model outperformed the most recent approach with outstanding results regarding performance metrics. The proposed model made quantitative errors with an MAE of 4.71 (RMSE) of 1.30 and an (R2) value of 0.68. These measurements show this 3DCNN model’s outstanding ability to predict LVEF from echocardiography video sequences with high levels of accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Edge Network Security in Fog Computing: A Hybrid Authentication and Encryption Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The rapid proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) devices has led to the growth of fog computing, which aims to provide efficient data processing and storage at the network edge. However, this expansion has also led to critical security concerns. This paper introduces a proposed hybrid authentication and encryption method designed to secure the edge network within fog computing. Our approach combines a password-based authentication mechanism with the robust Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm to ensure secure communication among IoT devices and fog nodes. Moreover, we introduce a distributed password mechanism for user authentication during the registration process, further bolstering the security of the fog environment. To assess the effectiveness of our proposed approach, we conducted evaluations and comparisons with existing authentication and encryption techniques in previous work. The results demonstrate the superior security capabilities of our method in fortifying the fog computing environment by preserving the time consumed whereas in the original 0.601 and in the proposal 0.611 which consider emerging challenges posed by IoT and fog computing.

articleTitle: Fraudulent Taxi Driver detection in Baghdad City based on DBSCAN and A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: In Modern cities, fraudulent taxi drivers who take unnecessary detours to overcharge passengers are a major problem in the transportation sector. Therefore, the analysis of taxi driver behavior is an urgent issue to improve the taxi service in any city. Due to this, an efficient system for detecting a fraudulent taxi driver has been suggested; the system firstly, supports the DBSCAN algorithm to construct the jam-distance graph which reflects the actual distance and traffic jam status together of the road network. Secondly, the algorithm has been supported to find the optimal path between two locations based on a jam-distance graph. Finally, a trajectories similarity has been used to measure the dissimilarity between the actual path of the taxi driver and the optimal path to determine the fraudulent taxi driver. The result shows that the proposed system has similar outlier detection accuracy (0.944) based on the TPR rate as compared with STR (0.945), FraudMove (0.921), and iBOAT (0.922). On the other hand, the proposed system (0.2 sec) has less response time for large inquiries as compared with STR(0.5 sec), FraudMove (0.7 sec), and iBOAT (0.9 sec) since the DFT-RN for building its database for finding an optimal path which saves time.

articleTitle: Detecting Abusive Activity with Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: There is a growing reliance on surveillance systems for law enforcement and public safety purposes. Video surveillance scenarios, such as those seen in train stations, schools, and hospitals, must automatically detect hostile and suspicious behavior to avoid social, economic, and environmental harm. Human contact can now be seen using intelligent video surveillance systems. Crowds and the camera’s field of view reduce the system’s effectiveness as a security procedure. As a result, there is a lot of study on the many strategies for detecting violent behavior. The method of detection discussed in this study can be divided into three categories. These groups were established as a result of the classification procedures that were used. Among the categorizations is a refined CNN for using AI to identify instances of violence. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to develop techniques for feature extraction and violence detection. The AIRTLab dataset was utilized to analyze models based on dataset learning for violence detection by testing the resilience of algorithms against false positives. To evaluate the proposed model’s robustness against false positives, we calculated accuracy measures and utilized them to establish a baseline on the AIRTLab dataset. The study literature claims a 99.98% success rate for the suggested models, with transfer learning-based networks boasting greater generalization abilities.

articleTitle: Detecting Fraudulent Taxi Drivers: Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: This review paper provides an overview of the techniques and approaches employed in the detection of fraudulent taxi drivers. By analyzing various studies and methodologies, the significance of addressing this issue in the transportation industry is highlighted. Different approaches, including anomaly detection techniques, machine learning algorithms, and network analysis, are discussed in the context of identifying suspicious patterns and behaviors exhibited by fraudulent taxi drivers. The utilization of large-scale transaction data, GPS data, and other relevant information is emphasized for effective fraud detection. The effectiveness of techniques such as clustering, classification, outlier detection, and feature selection in detecting anomalies and fraudulent activities in taxi services is explored. The integration of spatial, temporal, and cost factors is shown to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of fraud detection systems. However, challenges such as the evolving nature of fraudulent tactics, real-time detection requirements, and privacy concerns associated with data collection and analysis persist.
