Further research and development efforts are necessary to address these challenges and advance the field of detecting fraudulent taxi drivers. Overall, this paper provides a valuable overview of the techniques and approaches employed in the detection of fraudulent taxi drivers, enabling transportation authorities and service providers to proactively combat fraudulent activities, enhance passenger safety, and maintain the integrity of the taxi industry.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Chronic Heart Disease Based on Electronic Triage Dataset by using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Chronic Heart Disease (CHD) is the main reason for mortality around the world, constituting about 15% of all natural deaths, which confirms the importance of early detection to mitigate these rates. CHD can be detected by measuring multiple health parameters such as blood pressure, SpO2, ECG, and other parameters. Therefore, there is a persistent need for effective and precise prediction methods. Traditional techniques for prediction and analysis are limited due to the complexity of the data and correlations. First approach for developing these techniques is by using machine learning (ML) algorithms. ML can examine vast amounts of patient information, including medical records, test outcomes, and imaging scans to identify patterns and predict the possibility of developing heart disease or having a cardiac event. This study aims to improve the accuracy of prediction by utilizing ML techniques to predict CHD using medical data, reduce the incidence of misdiagnosis, and ultimately save lives. Supervised learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), AdaBoost, Logistic Regression (LR), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and others are employed to identify correlations in CHD data and enhance prediction rates. The results indicate that SVM-derived probabilistic models outperform other algorithms in predicting CHD and the accuracy of the model was 96.2%, as revealed through various performance evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Enhance the Security of Access to IoT-based Equipment in Fog
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things is in users’ daily life/work, as a result protecting privacy and security is essential. IoT’s heterogeneous, Pervasive, complicated properties make the problems of security important. Moreover, big nodes and resource limitations number make a lightweight need for algorithms of IoT security. So, attribute-based encryption (ABE) is the famous answer for the safe sharing, storage, and transfer of data in shared areas like IoT. In this paper, we propose a technique for user authentication with lightweight attribute-based encryption for IoTs in fog. With the security analysis performed, it is observed that the proposed technique prevents from the user attempting to decrypt messages that are not allowed, and thus, power dissipation and processing will be prevented for performing computational operations and processes that are spent with energy and time. Consequently, by performing this authentication before decoding, in addition to securing the security system, by removing the computational overheads required to achieve satisfaction at the requesting node, it adds the security technique performance used on the network. The results of the performance analysis show that overall, the proposed security framework has performed well.

articleTitle: Biometric Fusion Approaches Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Spoofing attacks have increased significantly, and a lot of research is being done on biometric security systems. Researchers are more interested in multimodal biometrics to give better security using biometric applications. A complicated model structure with minimal risk of spoofing attack can be created using multimodal biometrics applications. The new multimodal human identification model presented in this paper was created by fusing the two multimodal biometrics methodologies (face, iris, and fingerprint). The Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) that form the system’s structure extract features from the photos and use the Softmax classifier to categorize them. Five different CNN algorithms (VggNetl6, ReseNet50, MobilevNet, DenseNet, GoogleNet) are used with two fusion approaches (score and feature level). The designed automatic identification system is conducted on the SDUMLA-HMT dataset, the best-acquired accuracy results are 99.37% for score-level fusion and the accuracy is 97.55% with a feature-level fusion approach when the VggNetl6 algorithm is used. This system’s accuracy results are outperforming the latest current method methods.

articleTitle: Image Generation Conditioned on Text Using Deep Learning Models: Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Generating an image from textual input poses a significant challenge, which has garnered substantial global interest in recent times. To address this issue, deep learning is developed especially generative models. This work aims to introduce an introductory overview and critical evaluation of various models. This study also presents some of the datasets used for image generation from text, also the evaluation metrics used to assess the results of models used to generate images from text. A summary of previous work is also presented.

articleTitle: Literature Review for Health Secure Image Steganography and Visual Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: The security image of medical data for transmission is considered highly important during communication issues because of the sensitive information of medical. Encryption and steganography are used to ensure that patient medical information is not accessible by unauthorized individuals. This paper presents a literature review for medical image security by encryption and steganography. This literature review discusses twenty-one publications with various applied steganography and encryption of medical image security techniques. This paper provides the research knowledge basis for researchers to have a solid background for their proposed contributions. All approaches are distributed based on two groups the encryption and steganography techniques. The main metrics in this survey to investigate and evaluate model performance was considered PSNR, NPCR, UACI, SSIM, and MSE. When compared to the methods steganography, the results have shown interesting results.

articleTitle: Text Classification Accuracy Enhancement Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Machine-learning systems are part of the field of artificial intelligence that automatically learn models from data to make better decisions. Natural language processing (NLP), using object and learning approaches, performs well in statistical tasks, such as text classification or sentiment mining. Currently, in the field of natural language processing (NLP), various models, methods, and architectures have been proposed and a wide range of NLP tasks have been developed. Most natural language processing (NLP) problems can be formulated as classification problems (decide on the class of this object depending on the object and its context). In this field, machine learning methods and especially using neural network models are the most used. In this research, we propose a deep learning architecture for text classification that can influence model performance. The basic steps of this proposed method include text pre-processing (including sentence segmentation, punctuation, rooting, speech tagging, and vector conversion), text feature extraction, and LSTM algorithm-based classification model construction. The dataset used in this study is 20NewsGroup and IMDB. The evaluation results are provided in the form of MSE, Precision, Recall, Accuracy, and F-Measure evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Secure Mutual Authentication Scheme in Fog Computing: Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: As fog computing becomes more widespread, security issues become increasingly critical. Mutual authentication between fog nodes and end-users is a crucial part of fog computing security. This review paper presents the recent literature on secure mutual authentication systems in fog computing. The concept of mutual authentication and fog computing and the techniques used are extracted and explained; at the end of the paper. The most prominent technologies used in mutual authentication and fog computing were discussed in detail. This field received great and continuous attention and development to improve mutual authentication and provide high performance and efficiency. The paper may be helpful to researchers in the field of security and improving mutual authentication. Finally, our study aims to assist the prospective researcher by explaining security issues, open challenges, and future scopes in the mutual authentication scheme in fog computing.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Approach for Analysis of Telco Customer Churn
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Telco is a telephone service provider that gives data communications access. Information technology and the capability to stay connected and communicate all day are becoming the modern living trend. Telco company offers different promotions and services to attract consumers to select their telco company. The current service is inexpensive, and the quality of most telco companies is the same. Understanding the customer churn rate is crucial as it is highly associated with customer retention. This paper classified customer churn based on various attributes and utilized four different machine learning algorithms: Averaged Perceptron (AP), Bayes Point Machine (BPM), Decision Forest (DF), and Logistic Regression (LR). Microsoft Machine Learning Studio is used for Implementing and Testing Classification Models. The models are evaluated on Telco Customer Churn (TCC) dataset in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and error. The experimental results show that the LR model has an average accuracy of 80.1% compared to the other three models, in which AP scores 79.92%, BPM scores 80.04%, and DF scores 77.04%. The obtained results can provide significant insights for telecommunications companies to recognize market demands and develop appropriate strategies to enhance customer retention.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in Networks using Honey Badger Algorithm with improved Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: An Intrusion detection system IDS is a key component of the security management infrastructure. The goal of IDS is to monitor the processes prevailing in a network and to analyze them for signs of any possible deviations. Because of the large volume of data, the network gets expansion with a false alarm rate of intrusion, and detection accuracy decreased. It is one of the main problems in unknown attacks on network experiences. The basic aim was to develop accuracy also reduce the false alarm rate (FAR). We will design an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy based system to identify the intrusion activities within a network effectively. The Honey Badger Algorithm with an improved Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (HBA-IANFIS) is used to address the problems presented. The IANFIS combines an artificial neural network and a fuzzy interference system. To enhance the performance of the IANFIS model, the Honey Badger Algorithm is used to optimize the IANFIS. The intrusion detection results based on the NSL-KDD dataset were better and more efficient than those models because the detection rate was 96.68%, and the FAR result was 0.438%.

articleTitle: Medical Drug Data Cluster Analysis Using Mimetic Optimization Technique Combined with Chaotic Logistic Maps
publicationTitle: 2023 Al-Sadiq International Conference on Communication and Information Technology (AICCIT)
abstract: Medical drug classification is considered one of the industrial applications that Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning can help to do that task. The Drug interactions, namely drug-drug (DDI), drug-target, and drug-food interactions, might stimulate unexpected adverse drug Effects (ADEs). In this paper, we propose a machine learning technique that utilizes Memetic optimization to efficiently classify the drugs category in an unsupervised manner. This is beneficial for pharmacists and people working in the pharmaceutical industries to have an automatic means that enable them to categorize drugs according to their chemical structures. This work combines the Evolutionary Algorithm with the Chaotic Logistic Maps to produce a global and local memetic hybridization. As a result, the proposed method outperformed the traditional k-means clustering in terms of the accuracy measure with an accuracy double obtained using the conventional method.
